crossRefs.note: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.
I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.
The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly…
Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful…
Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break…
Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t…
Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal; for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his…
Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry…
When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing…

translations.web: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

translations.kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
